request.subject: UNIT:CULT:HERALD

layers.text: Change only three colours. The starry robe becomes a violet-leaning indigo blue, colour #4a43b5 on the lit left side and #372f8f in the folds, not grey and not navy. The white of the one big eye becomes pale yellow, colour #ffe27a, with the black pupil kept. The collar becomes polished yellow brass, colour #c9a24a. Keep the cream stars, the teal tentacles, the shape, the thick black outline and the art style the same, on a transparent background.
